title: SSAM release manifest (ssam-release/1)
description: release.json at the root of releases\<version>\ (docs/DISTRIBUICAO.md). It describes layout and version only: deleting it never turns a release into a checkout (the mode is the bundle constant RELEASE and the build switch SSAM_RELEASE). Its integrity comes from release.sig.jws (payload {typ: 'ssam-release/1', iat, version, files: [{path, size, sha256}]}, signed by the 'release' intermediate), checked by the O11 hook h1, ssam_update and ssam_doctor.

version.description: AAAA.M.N. The same version is embedded in every .NET binary as the constant Ssam.Lic.Build.Release (generated/Build.g.cs); the license gates compare that embedded constant with minRelease of the lease and of the CRL and never read this field.

distributable.description: false when the build used the test roots (no publisher/roots.pub.json from the root ceremony, D-PLANO-3). A release with false is never distributed. The test twin (SSAM_LICENSE_TEST) is never packaged at all.

o11Lane.description: Optional. The O11 lane name the facade reports (workspace.mjs); default ss4. A release has one installed Service Studio, located at run time.

baseline.description: The Studio versions the release was compiled against (D2: the oldest supported).

supported.description: Base or newer, always behind the static check of Anvil.Connect before an attach.

hook.description: Anvil.Hook.<hook>.dll; a new hook gets a new name, never a replaced file

id.description: ODC3.Bridge.<id>.dll (D-DONOS-5): the version in the AssemblyName of platforms/odc/studio/bridge/Bridge.csproj at the build (a new id at every bridge bump)

kernelSha256.description: sha256 of the final (obfuscated) Anvil.Core.dll and Anvil.Core.Odc.dll: the kernel identity of the stamped proofs.

obfuscated.description: Optional: assembly file name -> false when it ships without renaming (D-PLANO-4). Absent means every .NET assembly was obfuscated.

files.description: Every file of the release except release.json and release.sig.jws, with relative paths. No OutSystems file is ever listed.

authenticode.description: D1: NotSigned while there is no certificate

relativePath.description: Relative to the release folder, with '/', never absolute, never '..', no backslash
